name: fk-po
description: FlowKeeper product-owner tooling for Cowork. Ships six complementary skills. Three cover the explore → brainstorm → ticket flow: fk-po-explore (read-only product-language explanation of existing features), fk-po-brainstorm (pre-ticket grilling loop for fuzzy ideas), and fk-po-ticket (full spec + Jira ticket creation with screenshot attachments). fk-po-bug-video reproduces a PO-described bug on acceptance in a recorded browser and files an annotated Jira Bug. fk-po-release-notes (fk-release-notes) drafts EN+NL release-note items from shipped Jira tickets for the PO to review and publish manually. The ticket and brainstorm flows are docs-aware: they grow FlowKeeper's product glossary (CONTEXT.md) and decision log (docs/adr/) inline so the team's shared language compounds over time. Plus fk-po-help-video: the PO names a subject, Claude resolves the route from the frontend code and the running app, proposes a storyboard and proves it walks in a browser before any spend, then records a Dutch video with voice-over, subtitles and chapter cards.
